title: Gundam
subtitle: the Universal Century and every alternate universe
blurb: 48 entries across every Gundam continuity: the Universal Century in release order, the alternate universes, and the major manga.
notes: The Universal Century is a single continuity released out of sequence, so the section runs in release order and every row's note carries its in-universe year — UC 0079 and so on. Watch by release or by calendar; the notes support either.

Every other calendar — Future Century, After Colony, After War, Correct Century, Cosmic Era, Anno Domini, Advanced Generation, Regild Century, Post Disaster, Ad Stella, After Apocalypse — starts fresh, and the notes say which entry opens each line. GQuuuuuuX is the exception: a branch of the Universal Century rather than a calendar of its own.

Live-action (G-Saviour, Gundam Build Real, the announced film), the SD comedy spinoffs, promotional shorts (Evolve, Twilight AXIS, the Battlogues and their like), Build Metaverse, compilation re-cuts of series already listed, and anything announced without a date.

Episode counts, dates and calendars are from Wikipedia's franchise media list; film runtimes from each film's article. Series weigh episodes × 24 minutes, so Unicorn and The Origin — hour-long episodes — count light. The second Hathaway film's runtime is from Japanese Wikipedia; the English article has none yet. Entries not out yet weigh nothing. Manga weigh zero by design.
